channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Rain Likely in Parts of Tamil Nadu Till January 9: IMD
item.description: The Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) has forecast rainfall in parts of Tamil Nadu from Sunday to January 9, even as the State continues to recover from a series of weather-related disruptions witnessed in recent weeks.

item.title: Venezuelan leader locked up in New York jail after capture by US
item.description: Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro has been locked in a notorious federal jail in New York after his capture by the US forces at a military base in his country, from where he had been taunting President Donald Trump.

item.title: Over 1.9 Lakh Applications for Voter Inclusion in West Bengal: ECI
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) has provided statistical details of applications for additions and deletions of names in the voters' list, submitted during the hearing sessions on claims and objections that began after the list was published on December 16, 2025.

item.title: BRS MLC Naveen Rao appears before SIT in phone-tapping case
item.description: The SIT notice to Naveen Rao has come amid reports that the SIT is likely to summon former Chief Minister and Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) President K. Chandrasekhar Rao (KCR) and BRS Working President K. T. Rama Rao for questioning.

item.title: ‘Warning to Our Enemies’: Trump Hails Venezuela Operation
item.description: US President Donald Trump said the arrest of Venezuelan leader Nicolas Maduro should serve as a warning to adversaries, declaring that the United States would not tolerate threats to its security or sovereignty.

item.title: Karnataka: 7 minors detained in two separate POCSO cases for assaulting girls
item.description: In the Ashok Nagar police station limits, a minor girl was subjected to sexual harassment and assault by two minors. The police have further stated that there are allegations that the girl's father was also assaulted by the accused.

item.title: ‘Gonna Cry So Much!’: Kriti Sanon Reacts to Sister Nupur’s Engagement
item.description: Bollywood beauty Kriti Sanon is unable to control her emotions as her younger sister Nupur Sanon got engaged to her long-time beau Stebin Ben.

item.title: Democrats accuse Trump administration of lying to Congress about US goal in Venezuela
item.description: They said that Congress had not been notified in advance and that US President Donald Trump's administration had previously lied to Congress about its goal in the oil-rich South American nation.

item.title: Chandrababu Naidu Rejects Revanth Reddy’s Claim on Rayalaseema Lift Project
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu on Sunday rejected his Telangana counterpart A. Revanth Reddy's claim that the coalition NDA government in the state halted the Rayalaseema Lift Project at the Congress leader's request.

item.title: Irfan Pathan Backs Mohammed Shami After ODI Snub
item.description: Former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan threw his support behind the experienced fast bowler Mohammed Shami after his omission from ODI squad despite his stellar performance in the ongoing Vijay Hazare Trophy.
